description_en: Queries the binding information between items and electronic shelf labels (ESLs)
description_zh: 查询商品和价签的绑定信息
kebab_example: aliyun cloudesl describe-binders --item-bar-code 6905605830000 --esl-bar-code 18bc5a630000 --store-id s-dxsxx0000 --page-number 1 --item-title '纯牛奶' --page-size 10 --extra-params example-string --api-version 2020-02-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBinders

parameters.help_en: The bar code of the item
parameters.name: item_bar_code

parameters.help_en: The bar code of the ESL. If you query by store ID and ESL bar code, you do not need to specify the shelf number or layer number
parameters.help_zh: 价签条码，使用门店ID+价签条码查询时，不用填写货架号和层号
parameters.name: esl_bar_code

parameters.help_en: The store ID or custom store ID defined by the merchant
parameters.help_zh: 门店ID或商家自定义门店ID
parameters.name: store_id

parameters.help_zh: 分页参数：当前页码，默认值1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页参数：每页显示条数，默认值10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: A reserved field. Ignore this parameter
parameters.name: extra_params
